entities.summary: Northeast Ohio Medical University (NEOMED) is a public medical school in Rootstown, Ohio, United States. Founded in 1973, the university has four colleges — in medicine, pharmacy, dentistry and graduate studies — and offers Doctor of Medicine (M.D.), Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm.D.) and Doctor of Dental Surgery (D.D.S.) degrees, as well as master’s and doctoral degrees. The university also has a broad research portfolio concentrated in seven focus areas, yielding research opportunities in medical and life science areas.
